'''August''' is the eighth month in the [[Wikipedia:Gregorian calendar|Gregorian calendar]]. It occurs in Wheel of Time world during [[Tammaz]] [[Tammaz 26|26]] to [[Maigdhal]] [[Maigdhal 28|28]].
